news.title: Pune civic body's property tax registrations take a hit in FY27
news.para: The Pune Municipal Corporation has seen a sharp decline in new property tax registrations this financial year, largely due to staffing shortages exacerbated by Special Intensive Revision duties. Current statistics reveal that the number of processed properties for 2026-27 falls well below standards. With over 7,000 complaints filed, the limited staff has managed to resolve many.

news.title: Platinum Corp to invest ₹260 crore across four Mumbai residential projects
news.para: Platinum Corp plans to invest ₹260 crore across four residential developments in Mumbai’s western suburbs, with a combined projected GDV of over ₹1,350 crore. Of the total investment, ₹160 crore will come from institutional funding and ₹100 crore through internal accruals.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh government plans auto mutation after property registration
news.para: Various government departments are joining forces with the stamp and registration department to introduce automatic property mutation. Each department is identifying pilot projects: the revenue department is honing in on specific revenue villages while urban development focuses on local bodies. The industrial development department is also collaborating with relevant authorities.

news.title: Mall operators' revenue growth may accelerate to 14-16% next fiscal on new supply: Crisil
news.para: New retail space is expected to contribute nearly two-thirds of the 14-16% revenue growth projected for mall operators next fiscal, compared with 10-11% growth this fiscal. Retail area is likely to expand by 4.5-5 million sq ft over this and next fiscal, while capex is estimated at ₹5,000-5,500 crore.

news.title: Blackstone’s GCC in Bengaluru anchors fresh $50 billion India plan
news.para: Blackstone has officially inaugurated a new global capability centre in Bengaluru, aiming to bolster its operational support. With plans to ramp up its investments in India from $51 billion to a staggering $100 billion over the next five years, the Bengaluru team will work closely with international teams and significantly expand its workforce by the end of the year.

news.title: Buying land? New record system to make plot categories easier to check in West Bengal
news.para: Bengal is set to revolutionize its land record systems by introducing a new classification framework that will be more user-friendly. This innovative approach categorizes land into 16 distinct headings, making it easier for buyers and officials to navigate. A 'Supra Category' column will enhance the Record of Rights for improved comprehension of land types, while existing classifications remain unchanged.

news.title: Tamil Nadu raises building height limit to 19.5 metres, eases norms in Chennai aquifer zone
news.para: Tamil Nadu has recently amended the Combined Development and Building Rules, 2019 for various developments. The permissible height for non-high-rise buildings has been raised from 18.3 metres to 19.5 metres. Parking space requirements for IT offices have also been reduced to improve feasibility. New regulations now allow for additional developments in the restricted aquifer recharge area in Chennai.

news.title: Dalmia Bharat posts loss of ₹205 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In the September quarter of FY27, Dalmia Bharat Ltd reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 205 crore, attributed to exceptional expenses and rising input costs. However, the company saw a 4.27 percent revenue growth, reaching Rs 3,563 crore year-on-year. They also faced significant impairment losses from power plants and a voluntary employee separation scheme, yet the board announced a commendable interim dividend of 200 percent for FY26-27.

news.title: WeWork India posts net profit of ₹20.43 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: WeWork India Management reported a 219.2 per cent rise in net profit for the quarter ending September 2026. The company's total income also increased by 34.3 per cent during the same period. WeWork India expanded its capacity by adding approximately 11,700 desks, bringing the total to 1.45 lakh desks. Overall occupancy rates improved significantly, with mature centres reaching an occupancy of 87.7 per cent.

news.title: AI has learned to read the world. Can it learn to speak to it?
news.para: Vaani AI Research is developing a self-serve platform for Voice AI agents skilled in 22+ Indian languages. This initiative targets improved lead conversion by swiftly handling customer inquiries in diverse languages. The focus on essential speech technology sets Vaani apart, as their models leverage substantially less data without sacrificing quality.

news.title: Shree Naman Group acquires JW Marriott Bengaluru, Crowne Plaza Pune for ₹1,800 crore
news.para: Shree Naman Group has completed the acquisition of JW Marriott Bengaluru for ₹1,611 crore and Crowne Plaza Pune for ₹189 crore. The transaction expands its operating hospitality portfolio to five hotels with about 1,000 rooms across Mumbai, Bengaluru and Pune.

news.title: Aditya Birla Real Estate's profit stood at ₹918.7 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd reported a remarkable turnaround with a consolidated net profit of Rs 918.70 crore for the quarter ending September, recovering from a net loss of Rs 17.82 crore during the same time last year. Total income surged to Rs 860.86 crore, significantly up from Rs 113.23 crore. In the first half of the fiscal year, the company reported a net profit of Rs 884.

news.title: Sugam plans ₹2,800 crore development across three Kolkata projects in FY27
news.para: Sugam plans to launch three residential projects aggregating about 5.5 million sq ft in FY27, involving an overall construction cost of more than ₹2,800 crore. The Kolkata-based developer is targeting ₹750-800 crore of sales value in FY27, compared with around ₹375 crore in FY26, and is also evaluating a ₹100 crore institutional capital raise.

news.title: India office gross leasing rises to record 61.06 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Gross office leasing across India’s top seven cities reached a record 61.06 million sq ft during January-September 2026, while net absorption rose 5.3% year-on-year to an all-time high of about 42 million sq ft. GCC leasing increased 30.6% YoY and accounted for 42.9% of total leasing.

news.title: Thiruvananthapuram: Technopark Phase III expansion gets environmental clearance
news.para: Technopark, located in Thiruvananthapuram, has secured the necessary environmental approval for its Phase-III expansion project. This significant milestone permits the development of IT facilities covering an area of 8.19 lakh sqm, aiming to create over 5,000 job opportunities. The project is also committed to strict environmental regulations, reinforcing flood management and sustainability through vigilant monitoring and reporting.

news.title: Upkeep agency blocks deliveries, house helps at Ajnara Homes in Greater Noida West over dues
news.para: Residents of Ajnara Homes recently decided to withhold maintenance fees for four months due to ongoing issues related to poor upkeep and unresolved complaints. In response, the builder's maintenance agency imposed restrictions on food deliveries and domestic help services, creating considerable hardship for residents who found themselves having to fetch groceries from the main gate.

news.title: USA: Home sellers are lowering their price and helping buyers to make a deal in a stagnant market
news.para: Homeowners nationwide are facing challenges in selling their properties amid a stagnant housing market and escalating mortgage rates. Many are finding themselves forced to reduce their prices and offer incentives just to attract buyers. This evolving market landscape is impacting vital life choices, including job relocations or downsizing. Consequently, a large volume of homes is left unsold for lengthy periods, intensifying the imbalance as sellers significantly outnumber potential buyers.
